title: 網路與社群
description: 上網與社群媒體的用語

sentences.en: The post that I shared on social media yesterday, which was about environmental protection, received over a thousand likes overnight.
sentences.zh: 我昨天在社群媒體上分享的關於環境保護的貼文，一夜之間獲得了超過一千個讚。

sentences.en: After changing my privacy settings to restrict who can see my profile, I noticed a significant decrease in unwanted friend requests.
sentences.zh: 將隱私設定改為限制誰能看到我的個人檔案後，我注意到不想要的好友邀請大幅減少了。

sentences.en: The influencer whose content I have been following for years finally started a podcast discussing technology and mental health.
sentences.zh: 我追蹤了好幾年的那位網紅終於開了一個討論科技與心理健康的播客。

sentences.en: To avoid falling victim to phishing scams, never click on suspicious links sent from unknown email addresses or messages.
sentences.zh: 為了避免成為網路釣魚詐騙的受害者，千萬不要點擊來自未知電子郵件地址或訊息的可疑連結。

sentences.en: The comment section under that controversial article, which attracted thousands of heated responses, was eventually disabled by the moderators.
sentences.zh: 那篇爭議文章下方的留言區吸引了數千則激烈回應，最終被版主關閉了。

sentences.en: Streaming high-definition videos on multiple devices simultaneously requires a stable internet connection with sufficient bandwidth.
sentences.zh: 在多台裝置上同時串流高畫質影片，需要有足夠頻寬的穩定網路連線。

sentences.en: The online community that I joined last month, dedicated to sharing coding tutorials, has helped me improve my programming skills.
sentences.zh: 我上個月加入的專門分享程式教學的線上社群，幫助我提升了程式設計技能。

sentences.en: Although the website claims to offer free downloads, it is actually filled with misleading advertisements and potentially harmful pop-ups.
sentences.zh: 雖然該網站聲稱提供免費下載，但實際上充斥著誤導性廣告和可能有害的彈出視窗。

sentences.en: Creating a strong password that combines uppercase letters, numbers, and special characters is the first step in protecting your online accounts.
sentences.zh: 建立一個結合大寫字母、數字和特殊字元的強密碼，是保護線上帳號的第一步。

sentences.en: The algorithm that determines which posts appear in your feed is based on your previous interactions and browsing history.
sentences.zh: 決定哪些貼文出現在你動態消息中的演算法，是基於你之前的互動和瀏覽歷史。

sentences.en: After my account was hacked by someone who gained access through a data breach, I immediately enabled two-factor authentication.
sentences.zh: 在我的帳號被透過資料外洩取得存取權的人駭入之後，我立刻啟用了雙重驗證。

sentences.en: The viral video, which was originally posted by an unknown creator, accumulated fifty million views within just three days.
sentences.zh: 那支由一位不知名創作者原始發佈的爆紅影片，在短短三天內累積了五千萬次觀看。

sentences.en: Subscribing to a virtual private network service allows you to browse the internet anonymously and access region-restricted content.
sentences.zh: 訂閱虛擬私人網路服務讓你能匿名瀏覽網路並存取地區限制的內容。

sentences.en: The group chat, which includes all twenty members of our project team, has become the primary channel for sharing updates.
sentences.zh: 包含我們專案團隊全部二十名成員的群組聊天，已經成為分享更新的主要管道。

sentences.en: Before posting personal information online, consider the potential consequences, as anything shared on the internet can be permanent.
sentences.zh: 在網路上發布個人資訊之前，請考慮潛在後果，因為在網路上分享的任何東西都可能是永久的。

sentences.en: The website loading speed, which directly affects user experience and search engine rankings, can be improved by optimizing image sizes.
sentences.zh: 網站載入速度直接影響使用者體驗和搜尋引擎排名，可以透過最佳化圖片大小來改善。

sentences.en: Managing multiple social media accounts for both personal use and business purposes has become a full-time job for many people.
sentences.zh: 同時管理個人使用和商業目的的多個社群媒體帳號，對許多人來說已經成為一份全職工作。

sentences.en: The online forum where I ask technical questions, which has an active community of experienced developers, always provides helpful answers.
sentences.zh: 我問技術問題的線上論壇有一個由經驗豐富的開發者組成的活躍社群，總是能提供有幫助的回答。

sentences.en: Enabling dark mode on websites and apps, which reduces blue light emission, can help minimize eye fatigue during nighttime browsing.
sentences.zh: 在網站和應用程式上啟用深色模式可以減少藍光發射，幫助減輕夜間瀏覽時的眼睛疲勞。

sentences.en: The trending hashtag that appeared on the platform this morning sparked a nationwide conversation about digital privacy rights.
sentences.zh: 今天早上出現在平台上的熱門標籤引發了全國性的數位隱私權討論。

sentences.en: Blocking a user who has been sending harassing messages is the most effective way to protect yourself from online bullying.
sentences.zh: 封鎖一直傳送騷擾訊息的使用者，是保護自己免受網路霸凌最有效的方式。

sentences.en: The browser extension that I installed to block advertisements has made my web browsing experience significantly faster and cleaner.
sentences.zh: 我安裝來阻擋廣告的瀏覽器擴充功能，讓我的網頁瀏覽體驗明顯更快更乾淨。

sentences.en: Sharing your real-time location with trusted contacts through messaging apps provides an additional layer of personal safety.
sentences.zh: 透過通訊應用程式與信任的聯絡人分享即時位置，提供了額外的人身安全保障。

sentences.en: The social media platform, which was originally designed for sharing photos among friends, has evolved into a massive marketplace.
sentences.zh: 那個原本為朋友間分享照片而設計的社群媒體平台，已經演變成一個龐大的市集。

sentences.en: Verifying information from multiple reliable sources before sharing it online helps prevent the spread of misinformation and fake news.
sentences.zh: 在網路上分享資訊前從多個可靠來源驗證，有助於防止錯誤資訊和假新聞的傳播。

sentences.en: The live stream that attracted over ten thousand concurrent viewers crashed the server because it exceeded the platform's capacity.
sentences.zh: 吸引超過一萬名同時觀看者的直播使伺服器當機，因為超出了平台的容量。

sentences.en: Clearing your browser cache and cookies regularly not only frees up storage space but also helps resolve many website loading issues.
sentences.zh: 定期清除瀏覽器快取和Cookie不僅能釋放儲存空間，還能幫助解決許多網站載入問題。

sentences.en: The internet speed test that I ran this morning showed that my actual download speed is far below what my provider promised.
sentences.zh: 我今天早上執行的網速測試顯示，我的實際下載速度遠低於我的供應商承諾的。

sentences.en: Joining an online study group, where members share resources and discuss topics in real time, has enhanced my learning experience.
sentences.zh: 加入一個成員即時分享資源和討論主題的線上讀書會，提升了我的學習體驗。

sentences.en: The terms of service agreement that nobody reads before clicking accept often contains important clauses about data collection and usage.
sentences.zh: 沒有人在點擊同意前閱讀的服務條款協議，通常包含關於資料蒐集和使用的重要條款。
